# Feature Request

## Context

What workflow or user problem does this improve?

## Expected Behavior

Describe the proposed outcome.

## Files Likely Involved

List known files or folders.

## Agent Or Tool Used

Name the agent, CLI, script, or workflow if relevant.

## Validation Evidence

How should this change be validated?

## Governance Impact

Does this affect governance, validation, traceability, review policy,
source-of-truth files, hooks, or agent operating rules?

## Scope Boundaries

What should remain out of scope?
